summary: Provides utility functions to parse, validate, and auto-detect technology stacks based on project file presence.
responsibilities: Normalize and validate stack identifier strings against a Zod schema
Identify programming languages or package managers by scanning directory contents for specific manifest files
Ensure unique entries in stack lists after detection and parsing

symbols.name: parseStackValues
symbols.summary: Splits, trims, and validates a raw input array of stack strings.

symbols.name: detectStackFromFilenames
symbols.summary: Scans the project directory for configuration files to heuristically determine the technology stack.

symbols.name: uniqueStack
symbols.summary: Removes duplicate entries and validates the stack array.
